title: Stored revision registry
responsibility: Projects a revision’s declared units and scenarios with their graph, version identities and reviewed limits.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.manifests
inputs.description: Unit manifests stored at the revision; entries are sorted by id without filtering status.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.scenarios
inputs.description: Scenario manifests stored at the revision; entries are sorted by id.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.blobs
inputs.description: Optional owned-file path to blob-hash map, default empty; absent files contribute an explicit absent marker to unit versions.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.baselines
inputs.description: Optional reviewed budget baseline map by unit, default empty.

outputs.name: revisionRegistry
outputs.description: Registry view containing units, scenarios and declared dependency/coverage edges, with per-unit version hashes and applicable reviewed limits. Available is false with a gap when there are no units.
